bug_semantics: Anyquery server mode (`anyquery server`) binds a MySQL-protocol TCP port and, by default, authenticates with AuthServerNone when --auth-file is empty. Every SQLite connection registers built-in virtual-table modules (json_reader, csv_reader, later log_reader and others). Those modules take a caller-supplied file/URL argument and pass it to openMmapedFile/downloadFile, which builds a HashiCorp go-getter Client with no scheme, IP, or metadata-address restriction and fetches the source. An unauthenticated client can therefore CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING log_reader('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/') (or json_reader with the same URL) and SELECT the response, using the server as an SSRF proxy to loopback, RFC1918, and cloud metadata.
flaw_origin: Server mode already existed and forwarded arbitrary SQL, including CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE, before any URL-fetching reader existed. The SSRF primitive was first written in edfe9dcb68ffcf6c5832c5f2f6a1ef79909ed6e6 (2024-06-26, 'Add JSON and CSV tables'): new module/helper.go downloadFile/openMmapedFile using unrestricted go-getter, json_reader/csv_reader Connect calling openMmapedFile on the user URL, and namespace.Register installing those modules on every connection the server uses. log_reader (05c4dea951597e087a43e061b322f62893e833fb) later reused the same helper; it is not the first write. No SSRF/private-IP guard was present until the 0.4.5 sandbox.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GHSA-hwrq-8wxh-q4xv/CVE-2026-54628 is a real server-mode SSRF. The attack path is unauthenticated MySQL SQL -> CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE using a built-in reader -> go-getter fetch of an attacker URL, including 169.254.169.254. CVE.org/NVD had no CVE-2026-54628 record at audit time, but the vendor GHSA is published (withdrawn_at null), OSV carries the GHSA, and 0.4.5 names this advisory, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. Server mode (39938379, 2024-06-16) predated URL-fetching readers and is therefore not the BIC: at that point there was no virtual table that would issue HTTP. The smallest first-write of the flawed mechanism is edfe9dcb68ffcf6c5832c5f2f6a1ef79909ed6e6, which added unrestricted go-getter downloadFile and registered json_reader/csv_reader on the same Namespace.Register the server already called. Direct parent-tree check at bda27e2926a4bfbf621ba11f2b40611a2d5e9233 shows helper.go, read_json.go, and json_reader registration absent, so the vulnerable lines are new at the BIC (single-parent feature commit, not a move/refactor/squash). log_reader, used in the advisory PoC, only reused openMmapedFile two months later and is not a finer BIC. The 0.4.5 sandbox commit 27f84fc168310455eaf81ec4ba87eed20298670c is the direct fix: server sandbox on by default, AllowRemote false, CheckSource plus go-getter file-only getters, and tests against the metadata URL. It is not in 0.4.4 and is an ancestor of tag 0.4.5. AI is judged only on the BIC commit object: human maintainer julien040, no AI trailer or bot identity, so verdict is NOT_AI.
